subject.title: fix(codex): native patches fail and fast mode is ignored

question: Does the Codex/QA owner approve this native-event recognition and fast-mode propagation after directly checking the current app-server contract and sibling runtime paths?
rationale: The PR changes how externally generated native patch evidence is accepted and reported, and it is explicitly marked for maintainer handling; that boundary cannot be safely approved from the available metadata alone.

options.title: Complete contract review
options.body: Compare the parser and service-tier forwarding with the current upstream Codex protocol and merge only if all sibling transcript paths preserve the same security and counting invariants.

options.title: Narrow the patch
options.body: If the current contract does not guarantee one of the accepted representations, retain only the documented native-event form and add focused regression proof.

recommendation.title: Complete contract review
recommendation.body: Compare the parser and service-tier forwarding with the current upstream Codex protocol and merge only if all sibling transcript paths preserve the same security and counting invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the immediately preceding merged Codex/QA implementation and the follow-up patch, making them the clearest available routing candidate.
